payload.artist_html: Lindsay E. Zanno​1,2, Khishigjav Tsogtbaatar3, Tsogtbaatar Chinzorig3,4, Terry A. Gates
payload.description_html:
Dentary teeth of Erlikosaurus andrewsi (MPC-D 100/111).

(A, B) distalmost dentary teeth, (D–F) more mesial dentary teeth; (G) crowns three and four (counting from midline); (H) crowns one and two. All teeth shown in lingual view. Scale bar 1 mm.
